title: Implement Gemini UX feedback (core)
description:
Context
- Apply Gemini review feedback to improve first-run and core interaction flow.
- Scope: renderer UX + settings; no IDE/VScode fork; keep simple.

Plan
1) Replace blocking alert()/prompt() with in-app modal + toast notifications.
2) Soften onboarding: no forced Settings modal; show welcome/CTA in main canvas.
3) Make plan review primary: show plan as central overlay when required.
4) Do not auto-switch workspace on file drop; treat drops as attachments.
5) Simplify Settings with tabs (General/Connection/Advanced).
6) Add inline API key verification.

Acceptance
- No native browser dialogs are used for app flow.
- Fresh install with no key shows friendly onboarding and clear action to set key.
- Planning requires explicit review in a prominent UI before execution.
- Dropping a file never changes the configured workspace automatically.
- Settings are split into clear sections.
- API key can be verified from Settings with a clear success/failure indicator.

Risks
- Electron IPC changes must remain secure (do not log secrets).
- Network call for key verification must be lightweight and handle failures.

Tests
- Run `make all`.
close_reason: Completed via PR #7 (merged); tests: make test

title: Cowork Mode v0: task queue + activity log + skills
description:
Context
- Bring Cowork-style delegation to Ensign without overcomplicating: queue tasks, run in background, and show structured activity (commands/files/MCP/search/todos).
- Skills = lightweight prompt packs discovered under `.ensign/skills/*/SKILL.md` and injected into the task prompt.
- Scope expansion (v0) via Permissions = `danger-full-access` (full disk) with explicit plan permission; per-directory allowlists (`--add-dir`) are blocked until the bundled Codex is upgraded.

Scope (v0)
- Task queue managed in main process with concurrency limit.
- Per-task streamed output + Activity log derived from Codex JSON events.
- Cancel/stop queued and running tasks.
- Settings:
  - Concurrency
  - Experimental: web search, plan tool, config overrides (`-c key=value`)
  - Skills selection (IDs stored in settings; injected into prompt)
- Plan preview surfaces full-disk permission, search/plan-tool steps, and skills count.

Non-goals (v0)
- Browser automation.
- Mid-run interactive approvals for arbitrary tool calls (beyond plan gating).
- Cloud sync.
acceptance_criteria:
- User can queue multiple tasks; app stays responsive; tasks run sequentially or with limited concurrency.
- Each task shows live output + Activity timeline derived from Codex JSON events.
- User can cancel a queued or running task.
- Skills are discoverable in .ensign/skills and can be enabled; selected skills are injected into the prompt.
- Scope expansion is explicit: full-disk access requires choosing danger-full-access and granting the full-disk permission in the plan.
notes: Shipped v0.3: task resume (thread_id), needs-input status + reply UI, MCP connectors manager (list/add/remove), and full-disk-read toggle with plan permission + sandbox_permissions override. make all green; DMG rebuilt/signed (not notarized).
